transcript.text: I was reminiscing about that Shanghai trip back in 2025—someone in our group kept joking about how we basically lived off restaurant-hopping.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One lunch that stuck with me was at a place called Chuanfu Laozao; I remember it because the name sounded so dramatic.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It was on 2025-03-17, and we squeezed in at 11:30—pretty sure it was a table for 6, so it felt like a mini reunion.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Liu Yang handled the reservation details at the time; I still have the contact saved as 13845935572, which is kind of funny now.

transcript.text: Then later that year we were in Beijing and everyone was talking about shows nonstop—felt like there was something happening every night.
